The part is not finished in the make.sh sense: make.sh stops at its roof step because roof.json (the Roofs part) is missing, so build.nbt was not written. The verified output is build.next.nbt (1814 cells, walkable, the west face read by zoom).
Unlisted additions, noted in plan.md: east shutters on x=17 at z=9 and z=12, and the back lantern standing at (7,1,23).

waste.what: Worked out the Mann-brace facing for each single daub panel (z=9,14,19,21 on both faces) by hand: nearest post along z, ties to north
waste.cost: about 4 brace cells, reasoned once and typed into the module
waste.tool: a vocab helper like braceFacing(z, posts) or a sideFacade(g, x, posts, braces) that places the braces and glazing from the post list

waste.what: Chose shutter facing for each side (east for the west wall, west for the east wall, south for the wing's north face) by reasoning about the trapdoor hinge convention
waste.cost: several minutes of reasoning, then one zoom to confirm the west face
waste.tool: shutterPair with a wall-side argument that takes the wall's axis and side, or a note in the palette/plan stating the facing rule for each wall

waste.what: Had to check by eye whether the shell and roof left cells free (the gable vent cell, lantern support); found out only by running
waste.tool: mcd plan or check reporting which opening cells are still air before a part runs, so a part can list its own cells against them

waste.what: make.sh cannot finish until roof.json exists, so a part cannot be verified as a whole build.nbt while the Roofs part is still a stub
waste.cost: a dead end at the make.sh roof step; had to render build.next.nbt directly
waste.tool: make.sh that skips the roof step when roof.json is absent (warn, not fail), or a stub roof.json, so each part can be verified alone

left: make.sh cannot produce build.nbt yet: it stops at the roof step because roof.json (written by the Roofs part, still a stub) is missing. Re-run ./make.sh once the Roofs part writes roof.json; the sides part itself wrote with 0 refusals and 0 off-palette blocks.
The wing door lantern at (22,4,17) hangs on a chain from the wing eave (22,6,17), which only exists after the Roofs part; until then the structure check flags it as unsupported.

The wing vent trapdoor at (19,7,13) and the back attic window at (11,15..16,22) sit in gable triangles that the Roofs part may fill; if the Roofs part writes them first, they will be refused on the next make.sh run.

plan.md checklist item 6 is not ticked because make.sh has not produced build.nbt; the elements.md item 'Bakehouse wing' is ticked. The 'Lanterns' item stays open for part 4 (under the jetty) and part 6 (the back and wing lanterns are placed).
